content:
Maya Patel: quick design review — pushed a small prototype for a condensed invoke timeline + inline schema quick-insert in the Playground. want rapid feedback before i hand it to eng.
Sam Kim: saw it! love the compact timeline but concerned about discoverability for the function defs. feels hidden when collapsed.
Maya Patel: agree. current idea: keep a 1-line pill that says `3 tools · edit` which expands on hover or tap. accessibility-wise we need keyboard focus and aria-expanded.
Leo Huang: keyboard expansion is doable. we should also support `Enter` and `Space` on the pill. aria-controls -> id of the expanded panel.
Olivia Ruiz: copy nit: `3 tools · edit` reads like a counter. maybe `3 function definitions` or `3 tool definitions`? shorter: `3 defs`? not great.
Priya Nair: prefer `3 functions` — aligns with SDK naming. but maybe show full label on hover tooltip for small screens.
Sam Kim: also UX question: when you open a run in history, do we show the full schema or the diffs only? prototype shows full schema which is noise for long defs.
Maya Patel: thinking to show the most-recent schema summary + a collapsible diff. summary = name + arg list + return type. click `view full` to expand entire JSON.
Leo Huang: for diffs, use a compact inline diff bar with +/- counts instead of the long patch. users often want to know if an arg changed, not whole blob.
playground-bot: New prototype uploaded: https://playground.internal/r/compact-invoke-2026
Olivia Ruiz: visual affordance: when a tool call fails because of schema mismatch, we currently show a red line under the output. it's easy to miss. suggest an inline toast in the invocation row: `Tool call failed — schema mismatch. View suggested fix` with link to quick-edit.
Sam Kim: +1. also show the failing param name inline so devs can click and jump to the function def.
Priya Nair: a11y: color contrast on the pill is low on high-luminance themes. bump to 4.5:1 for normal text. also the expand chevron should have `aria-hidden=\"true\"` and the button must have a proper label: `Toggle function definitions`.
Maya Patel: thanks — will update tokens. small code snippet in the prototype for quick-insert (we show a tiny modal that inserts a skeleton):

```
{
  "name": "search_documents",
  "description": "Search internal docs",
  "parameters": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "query": {"type": "string"},
      "limit": {"type": "integer", "default": 5}
    },
    "required": ["query"]
  }
}
```

Sam Kim: modal looks fine. can we add a shortcut: `Cmd+K` to open quick-insert and `Shift+Enter` to accept with defaults?
Leo Huang: also suggest `esc` to close and `Ctrl+Enter` to insert and keep modal open (for rapid multiple inserts).
Olivia Ruiz: copy tweak for the run history filter: `Show only tool-calls` -> `Filter: tool calls` (shorter). also add an SR-only label `Filter run history to only show tool calls`.
Priya Nair: voiceover tests: when a user tabs into a collapsed run item, it reads `Run at 11:32 collapsed`. we should read `Run at 11:32, 2 tool calls, collapsed`. gives context.
Maya Patel: good point. also want to introduce a micro-CTA in the run header: `Re-run with latest defs` — this will revalidate and highlight schema mismatches inline.
Sam Kim: for mobile: the compact timeline becomes an accordion. be careful with swipe-to-dismiss gestures conflicting with horizontal token scrolling in the playground output.
Leo Huang: implement hit-area padding to avoid accidental swipes. and pinch-to-zoom should not collapse the timeline.
Maya Patel: final ask: can eng instrument telemetry events for `quick-insert.open`, `quick-insert.insert`, `run-history.expand`, and `schema-preview.view-diff`? we'll use to measure discoverability.
playground-bot: Telemetry event schema suggested: {event:string, ts:number, user_id:string, extra:object} — ensure PII-free.
Priya Nair: last tiny thing: add a role=\"status\" live region for toast errors so screen readers announce schema mismatch immediately.
Olivia Ruiz: love the `Re-run with latest defs` CTA. make it secondary style not to distract.
Maya Patel: thanks team — i'll update the Figma with these changes and ship a follow-up build. leaving action items in the prototype doc.
Sam Kim: thanks Maya — I'll queue up a11y tests and keyboard flows.
Leo Huang: i'll draft the telemetry PR.
Priya Nair: will run voiceover smoke tests once we have the build.
Maya Patel: :thumbsup\"
